programme.desc: An analysis of the construction mechanism for the magic in dominant narrative cinema though the filming of Nachts, wenn Dracula erwacht (1970), a commercial film by Jesus Franco.

programme.title: Ambition
programme.desc: At their ten-year high school reunion, a man convinces five successful friends to break into their old school. Once inside, the group gradually recalls trading one of their souls in exchange for their current fortunes. It doesn't take long for the collective to be beset by paranoia and distrust, torn between helping each other and helping themselves.

programme.title: End of the World
programme.desc: After witnessing a man's death in a bizarre accident, Father Pergado goes on a spiritual retreat, where he encounters his alien double bent on world conquest.

programme.title: El látigo negro contra los farsantes
programme.desc: Una banda de delincuentes adopta la identidad de «El Látigo Negro» para cometer delitos y poner al pueblo en su contra. Mientras su reputación se ve amenazada, el verdadero héroe deberá descubrir quiénes se esconden tras la máscara y demostrar la verdad.

programme.title: Los murciélagos
programme.desc: Un grupo de misteriosos criminales enmascarados llega a un pueblo y siembra el terror entre sus habitantes. Mientras el miedo se apodera de la comunidad, una amenaza oculta desafía a quienes se atrevan a enfrentarlos y descubrir quiénes se esconden tras las máscaras.

programme.title: Sólo el valiente
programme.desc: Un despreciado comandante de caballería es injustamente culpado por su tropa de la muerte de un popular oficial y debe redimirse ante sus hombres durante un ataque indio al fuerte.

programme.title: Nueva Frontera (New Frontier)
programme.desc: Los Tres Mesquiteers convencen a un grupo de colonos para que cambien sus propiedades actuales por otras que, sin saberlo nuestros chicos buenos, no van a tener ningún valor. Son capturados antes de que puedan avisar a los rancheros.

programme.title: Sentencia de muerte
programme.desc: Cuatro hombres mataron al hermano de Django hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: Las pruebas apuntan a Kozue
programme.desc: Kozue profesa un afecto un tanto retorcido por su hermano mellizo hasta el punto de emplear la fuerza para deshacerse de todo aquel que ose acercarse más de la cuenta a su querido Miki. Tras un violento suceso, es tentada por la mano negra de la sociedad de la rosa negra, que pretende aprovecharse de sus sentimientos.

programme.title: El cencerro de la felicidad
programme.desc: Nanami cree que el cencerro que le han regalado es un complemento y decide abrochárselo al cuello para lucirlo a diario. Sin embargo, tanto el cuerpo como la mente de Nanami comienzan a sufrir una serie de cambios paulatinos hasta transformarse en una vaca…

programme.title: Espinas que matan
programme.desc: Shiori, la que antaño fuera mejor amiga de Juri, se reincorpora a la academia Ohtori, pero Juri la trata con frialdad. La sociedad de la rosa negra le revela a Shiori los verdaderos sentimientos de Juri, aquellos que nunca ha confesado a nadie más.

programme.title: Mitsuru se impacienta
programme.desc: Mitsuru Tsuwabuki se molesta porque Nanami, su ídolo, sigue tratándolo como a un crío. A pesar de que prueba diversos métodos para parecer más mayor, más “adulto”, alguien a quien Nanami pueda ver como a un igual, sus intentos no parecen cuajar…

programme.title: La melodía de un reino caído
programme.desc: Tatsuya Kazami, a quien Wakaba admiraba y apodaba “el príncipe cebolla” cuando iban juntos a clase en la escuela primaria, reaparece ante ella. Para mayor sorpresa, en lugar de declararse a su antigua amiga, le pide una cita a Utena.

programme.title: El florecer de Wakaba
programme.desc: Wakaba acogió en su apartamento a Saionji tras ser sancionado con una expulsión y llevan días viviendo juntos. Wakaba siente que disfruta del “momento de esplendor” de una chica normal y corriente, como ella misma se considera. Sin embargo, esa dicha y felicidad tiene los días contados.

programme.title: La parásita
programme.desc: Keiko, una de las integrantes del trío de seguidoras de Nanami, está enamorada de Tôga. Nanami descubre el interés de Keiko por su hermano y decide castigarla con severidad. La rabia, la impotencia y la envidia se arremolinan en el interior de Keiko.

programme.title: El pabellón conmemorativo Nemuro
programme.desc: Shôji Mikage rememora cuando era conocido como el profesor Nemuro y participó investigando en el experimento que iniciaría el plan para obtener “el poder para revolucionar el mundo”. Fue entonces cuando tuvo lugar su encuentro con Tokiko Chida y su hermano pequeño, Mamiya…

programme.title: Campanita del lugar
programme.desc: Kaori y Kōsei se preparan para la gala musical de Towa. Pero cuando llega el momento de subir al escenario en el día de la gala, Kaori todavía no ha llegado, por lo que a Kōsei no le queda otro remedio que comenzar la actuación sin ella.

programme.title: El dolor del amor
programme.desc: Kōsei tiene que tocar sin Kaori en la gala musical. Se esfuerza mucho en demostrar sus grandes habilidades como pianista durante toda su actuación, a la vez que se enfrenta de nuevo con los recuerdos de su pasado.

programme.title: Huellas
programme.desc: Kaori no ha asistido a la gala musical ya que se encuentra en el hospital, por lo que Kōsei, Tsubaki y Watari deciden ir a visitarla. Tsubaki intenta aclarar sus propios sentimientos. Kōsei toma una decisión importante sobre su futuro.

programme.title: Mentiroso
programme.desc: Tsubaki se siente frustrada al ver que sus amigos avanzan en la vida mientras ella se ha quedado estancada, así que decide intentar recuperar el tiempo perdido. Hiroko se encuentra con Nagi, una joven con un gran talento musical.

programme.title: Tal para cual
programme.desc: Nagi se convierte en la primera estudiante de piano de Kōsei, aunque Hiroko la vigila atentamente ya que conoce sus intenciones ocultas. Kaori ya no puede seguir ocultándole su cada vez más deteriorado estado de salud a Kōsei.

programme.title: Crepúsculo
programme.desc: Kōsei va al hospital a visitar a Kaori. Nagi sigue aprendiendo de Hiroko y Kōsei. Ante la proximidad del festival de la escuela, Kōsei y Nagi empiezan a preparar una actuación conjunta. Nagi está nerviosa pero Hiroko la tranquiliza.

programme.title: Corazones que se unen
programme.desc: El público queda impresionado ante la increíble actuación de Kōsei y Nagi. Takeshi le pide a Kōsei la oportunidad de competir contra él en una próxima competición de piano. Kōsei le pide a Kaori que toque con él una vez más.

programme.title: Adiós, héroe
programme.desc: Kaori decide someterse a una arriesgada operación quirúrgica porque quiere volver a tocar con Kōsei y volver a subirse a un escenario una vez más. Mientras, Kōsei empieza a practicar para la próxima competición musical.

programme.title: Blue Thermal
programme.desc: Tamaki está emocionada ante la perspectiva de la vida universitaria, sin embargo, su vida cambia drásticamente cuando se enamora del cielo. Se muda a Tokio en busca de una vida universitaria normal llena de actividades de clubes y romance. Pero poco después de ingresar en la universidad, daña accidentalmente el planeador de un chico llamado Sorachi y acaba trabajando como asistente en el club de aviación para pagar los daños.

programme.title: ¡El chico que viene de China! ¡Es muy extraño!
programme.desc: “Viene Ranma”. Soun, el propietario del Dojo Tendo, está encantado con las noticias de que Ranma Saotome y su padre, quienes han estado entrenando en el arte del kung fu en China, regresan para cumplir la promesa de que Ranma se case con una de sus hijas. Sin embargo, cuando llegan al Dojo Tendo…

programme.title: La escuela no es un juego
programme.desc: Ranma ha decidido matricularse en el Instituto Furinkan, el mismo al que asiste Akane. Pero al llegar a las puertas del instituto, todos los chicos miembros de clubes deportivos les están esperando para atacarles.

programme.title: De repente tormenta del amor… ¡Espera un momento!
programme.desc: El capitán del club de kendo, Tatewaki Kuno, quien está perdidamente enamorado de Akane, desafía obstinadamente a un duelo a Ranma tras enterarse de que este se ha convertido en el prometido de la muchacha.

programme.title: ¿Ranma y Ranma? Los malentendidos no paran
programme.desc: Kuno se ha enamorado perdidamente de la chica de la coleta. Kuno, quien no tiene ni idea de quién es realmente, llama a Ranma y le confía un obsequio para ella.

programme.title: ¿Colado hasta los huesos? El amor de Akane causa fracturas
programme.desc: Tras provocarle contusiones en todo el cuerpo después de una gran trifulca, Akane lleva a Ranma a la clínica de osteopatía dirigida por el Doctor Tofu para que le trate.

programme.title: No hay nada que hacer con el corazón roto de Akane
programme.desc: Kasumi visita la clínica del Doctor Tofu, el célebre médico que está tratando a Ranma. Tan pronto como pone los ojos sobre Kasumi, el Doctor Tofu se pone nervioso y pierde los papeles.

programme.title: ¡Entra en escena! Ryoga, el que siempre se pierde
programme.desc: En el Instituto Funrinkan aparece un misterioso joven que busca a Ranma. Nada más ver a Ranma, de repente grita “¡Ranma, prepárate para morir!” y se lanza al ataque.

programme.title: ¡La escuela es un campo de batalla! El duelo de Ranma contra Ryoga
programme.desc: Dispuesto a hacer lo que sea necesario para acabar con la felicidad de Ranma, Ryoga le envía una carta de desafío. El enfrentamiento entre ambos da comienzo en el Instituto Furinkan.

programme.title: La confesión de una dama: el cabello es la vida para una mujer
programme.desc: Akane se ve involucrada en el duelo que enfrenta a Ranma contra Ryoga. ¡Y en medio del enfrentamiento, una bandana lanzada por Ryoga le corta su largo cabello! Preocupado por el hecho de que Akane se haya marchado conmocionada, Ranma decide ignorar el duelo e ir tras ella…

programme.title: P… P… P-chan. ¡No te metas con él!
programme.desc: Resulta que Ryoga también es una víctima de la maldición de Jusenkyo. Cuando se moja con agua fría, se transforma en un cerdito. Akane, que desconoce este hecho por completo, cuida del cerdito y duerme con él. Y cuando Ranma se entera…

programme.title: ¡Loca por Ranma! Aparece la capitana del equipo de gimnasia rítmica
programme.desc: El equipo de gimnasia rítmica del Instituto Furinkan al completo ha caído lesionado justo antes de su enfrentamiento contra la Academia Femenina San Hebereke y los miembros del club piden ayuda a Akane. Cuando Kodachi, la capitana del equipo de gimnasia rítmica de San Hebereke, se entera, lanza un ataque por sorpresa.

programme.title: ¡El amor de las mujeres es la guerra! Luchemos en la competición de gimnasia rítmica
programme.desc: Tras enterarse de que Ranma es el prometido de Akane, Kodachi le propone a esta jugarse a Ranma en la próxima competición. Sin embargo, Ranma aparece como sustituto de Akane cuando esta se lesiona el tobillo durante un entrenamiento especial.

programme.desc: Verano de 1984. Thatcher gobierna y el Sindicato Nacional de Mineros (NUM) ha convocado una huelga. Durante la manifestación del Orgullo Gay en Londres, un grupo de lesbianas y gays se dedica a recaudar fondos para ayudar a las familias de los mineros.

programme.title: Una amenaza en la sombra
programme.desc: Wes Rawlins es un cazarecompensas y hombre de pocas palabras. Queda devastado cuando su madre es asesinada por una pareja de forajidos.

programme.desc: Un veterano de guerra vuelve a casa, a la reserva de elefantes de su padre, donde tendrá que luchar contra unos cazadores furtivos.

programme.desc: En 1926, con su vida personal hecha jirones y su escritura en crisis, una joven Agatha Christie decide resolver un asesinato en la vida real.

programme.title: El falsificador
programme.desc: Un ladrón de poca monta se las arregla para conseguir que el sindicato donde trabaja su padre pague la fianza para poder salir de la cárcel y pasar tiempo con su hijo enfermo. Eso sí, tendrá que cumplir una condición para devolver el dinero prestado.

programme.title: Corrupción y poder
programme.desc: Un ambicioso y joven abogado acepta un caso importante contra un despiadado empresario de una farmacéutica, viéndose envuelto en un caso de chantaje y corrupción.

programme.title: Skyline
programme.desc: Después de una noche de fiesta, unos amigos se despiertan en medio de una invasión extraterrestre que intenta acabar con la humanidad. Ellos y los demás supervivientes deberán luchar por sus vidas mientras el mundo se desvanece a su alrededor.

programme.title: Valentine, venganza oscura
programme.desc: La tranquila ciudad de Batavia ya no es lo que era. La violencia, los robos y la gran tasa de criminalidad hacen de sus calles un lugar inhabitable. programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

The Studio71 co-founder and Underscore Talent co-founder and co-CEO has spent his career at the intersection of traditional entertainment and digital talent. Bloomberg TV is live from Asia with Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping markets — from tech, to geopolitics, and the world’s energy transition.

programme.title: Bloomberg: The China Show
programme.desc: "Bloomberg: The China Show" is your definitive source for news and analysis on the world's second-biggest economy. From politics and policy to tech and trends, Yvonne Man and David Ingles give global investors unique insight, delivering in-depth discussions with the newsmakers who matter.

programme.title: Insight with Haslinda Amin
programme.desc: In a volatile and unpredictable world, the show will be the definitive guide for the global news audience to get the complete picture on the biggest story of the day. With news making executives, officials and thought-leaders from the world of business, politics and academia we will explore a story through probing interviews and nuanced conversations. The hour of programming will also highlight the most relevant stories from India which is currently one of the hottest investment destinations, but also has compelling stories that play into the Bloomberg's priority issues such as Climate change, Diversity and Technological innovation.

programme.title: Bloomberg Horizons Middle East & Africa
programme.desc: A spotlight on the fast paced growth and major deals happening across the Middle East and Africa. Linking the market drivers from overnight in the US and across Asia into the region's trading day, with deep dive analysis of the top business, energy and geopolitical stories shaping the decisions of traders across the Middle East, Africa and beyond.

programme.title: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe
programme.desc: Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

programme.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
programme.desc: The Opening Trade has everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game.

programme.title: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua
programme.desc: The Pulse with Francine Lacqua is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

programme.title: Bloomberg Brief
programme.desc: Bloomberg Brief delivers the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

programme.title: Bloomberg Surveillance
programme.desc: Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern have the economy and global markets "under surveillance". Their daily conversations with leaders and decision makers from Wall Street to Washington and beyond cover the latest in business, investment, and geopolitics. No other program better positions investors and executives for the trading day.

programme.title: La Orden Judicial
programme.desc: Tras luchar en la Guerra Civil, dos compañeros de la Unión se encuentran en lados opuestos poniendo en peligro la paz de posguerra.

programme.title: Solo Por Una Noche
programme.desc: El esposo de una mujer casada con una vida perfecta engaña a su hermana, con consecuencias extremas.

programme.title: Proscrito
programme.desc: Un ex miembro del Royal Marine Commando descubre pruebas que podrían derribar a un funcionario corrupto y ponerlo tras las rejas de por vida. Cuando secuestran a su novia de la infancia, su misión es rescatarla y dejar que todo se interponga en su camino.

programme.title: Barcelona Noche de Invierno
programme.desc: Durante la Noche de Reyes, varias personas viven diferentes historias de amor, algunas alocadas e inusuales, y otras agridulces. Por un lado, un joven organiza una fiesta para recuperar a su exnovia, mientras que, paralelamente, el rey Melchor salta de la carroza en medio de la cabalgata para perseguir a una chica. Por otro lado, una abuela quiere compartir su secreto con toda la familia.

programme.title: Diddy: La Caída El Monstruo
programme.desc: El magnate del hip-hop caído en desgracia, Sean "Diddy" Combs, ya no pudo comprar su salida de los problemas cuando un gran jurado lo acusó en septiembre de 2024 de una conspiración de crimen organizado que incluía tráfico sexual, trabajo forzado y soborno. Sin fianza, iba a la cárcel.

2018 es un thriller de supervivencia en malayalam basado en las devastadoras inundaciones de Kerala de 2018. La película entrelaza múltiples vidas: un exmilitar convertido en comerciante, una reportera de televisión, un camionero y funcionarios del gobierno, cuyos caminos se cruzan en medio de la calamidad. A medida que suben las aguas, la gente común se convierte en héroe, arriesgando sus vidas para salvar a vecinos, desconocidos y comunidades.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror: Ataque Al Templo
programme.desc: Inspirada en hechos reales, la película narra la história heroica de los comandos NSG, que intervienen para salvar a personas inocentes cuando los terroristas atacan un templo en Gujarat.

programme.title: Linea del Condado: Todo o Nada
programme.desc: El asesinato de un dudoso abogado en la línea condal, obliga a dos sheriffs a dejar sus diferencias de lado para atrapar al asesino.

programme.title: Boogie: El Aceitoso
programme.desc: Boogie es un asesino a sueldo violento, despiadado y de sangre fría que sigue sus propias reglas. Las mujeres lo aman, los criminales le temen y su habilidad para matar le precede. Explotando con ironía, alcohol y balas ininterrumpidas, esta es una película animada en 3D asombrosa y llena de acción.

programme.title: USS Seaviper: Mision al Abismo
programme.desc: El submarino alemán U-234, del puerto de Kiel, comercia con los japoneses. El USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio. El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: En una obra de demolición, el vagabundo Jan Steinert observa a un hombre que esconde una bolsa de deporte verde mientras huye de la policía. Cuando el hombre desaparece, Steinert encuentra el botín del atraco a un banco: ¡53.000 euros! Sin que nadie se dé cuenta, Steinert coge el dinero y deja la bolsa.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Finn investiga por su cuenta tras ser suspendido por herir a un menor armado, hijo de un dueño de burdel.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Harry Siebert, instalador de paneles de yeso, es encontrado muerto a golpes en una obra. Su mujer, Klara, da la primera pista a los detectives: su marido quería reunirse con el jefe de obra, Jens Weigand, para reclamar su salario de los meses anteriores. Como Weigand quería aplazar de nuevo el pago, Harry se enfrentaba a la ruina económica.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Silke Bruhn, de 16 años, aparece muerta en el río Trave. Las primeras investigaciones revelan que fue golpeada antes de morir. Finn y Lars descubren rastros de un picnic en la orilla del río. ¿Se peleó la chica con un chico durante una cita? La madre de Silke y su hermano mayor, Niko, están completamente sorprendidos: Silke quería pasar la noche con su nueva novia.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Nadia Mönning, esposa de un reputado cardiocirujano de Lübeck, sorprende a un ladrón en su casa. Se enfrenta al hombre con una pistola y está a punto de llamar a la policía cuando el ladrón se revela. Se trata del fisioterapeuta de Nadia, Kai Thieme. En ese momento, el suegro de Nadia, Horst Mönning, enfermo terminal, llega para ayudarla.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Franziska aparece muerta en el coche de su marido en coma; sus hijastros podrían dejar el crimen impune.

programme.title: Asesinato en el norte, Temporada 7
programme.desc: Vanessa Kühn, una colegiala de 16 años, escapa por los pelos de un intento de secuestro. Una joven que intentó ayudarla resulta gravemente herida en la cabeza. Los detectives temen que el autor vuelva a intentarlo. Ordenan protección policial para Vanessa, que dirige un exitoso canal de belleza como influencer.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: Lo que al principio parece violencia de pandillas se convierte en un ataque terrorista coordinado. Varios lugares de Mumbai — CST, Café Leopold, Hotel Taj, Oberoi y Chabad House — son atacados al mismo tiempo. Parvati aprovecha el caos para demostrar su valentía periodística.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror: Ataque Al Templo
programme.desc: Inspirada en hechos reales, la película narra la história heroica de los comandos NSG, que intervienen para salvar a personas inocentes cuando los terroristas atacan un templo en Gujarat.

2018 es un thriller de supervivencia en malayalam basado en las devastadoras inundaciones de Kerala de 2018. La película entrelaza múltiples vidas: un exmilitar convertido en comerciante, una reportera de televisión, un camionero y funcionarios del gobierno, cuyos caminos se cruzan en medio de la calamidad. programme.title: Diddy: La Caída El Monstruo
programme.desc: El magnate del hip-hop caído en desgracia, Sean "Diddy" Combs, ya no pudo comprar su salida de los problemas cuando un gran jurado lo acusó en septiembre de 2024 de una conspiración de crimen organizado que incluía tráfico sexual, trabajo forzado y soborno. Sin fianza, iba a la cárcel.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Mientras el Dr. Blunt realiza un experimento de telepatía con una chinchilla, que deja su mente temporalmente atrapada en el cuerpo del animal, el Equipo Astro investiga los misterios del teatro "embrujado". Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

programme.title: Hecho en Chinatown
programme.desc: Es Goodfellas y Ip Man cuando un joven chino don nadie se propone convertirse en Don de la mafia italiana. Pero las tensiones ya son altas entre las dos culturas a medida que se mueven en el territorio del otro y un comisionado de delitos sucios juega en ambos lados. Resulta que ganarse el respeto, encontrar el amor y descubrir su identidad no es tan fácil. Tendrá que luchar para llegar a la cima.

programme.title: La Lucha de un Guerrero
programme.desc: Om es un súper comando que tiene la importante misión de devolver al Rashtra Kavach (que literalmente se traduce como guardia de seguridad del país) a buenas manos y salvar la nación. Está a punto de completar su misión cuando recibe un disparo y vuelve a la vida solo para darse cuenta de que ha perdido la memoria. Mientras tanto, Kavya Sharma se ocupa de él mientras otros funcionarios de la agencia gubernamental de élite, Murthy y Jai Rathod, están ocupados pensando cómo hacer que Om regrese a la misión. Pero no es tan sencillo como parece desde fuera. Mientras salva a su nación, Om tiene mucho más por descubrir: por ejemplo, encontrar a su padre Dev Rathod y demostrar que no era un traidor.

programme.title: Emergencias
programme.desc: Situaciones de emergencias al límite.

programme.title: Días de Invierno
programme.desc: Néstor se encuentra estancado en su vida como recepcionista de un hotel y sin un futuro claro. Siendo el hijo menor y el único que sigue viviendo con su madre, le cuesta tomar decisiones. Su madre ahora desempleada sufre una angustia interna que se agudiza con la dificultad de la venta de su casa y los recuerdo que acarrea.

programme.title: Hydra
programme.desc: El ex marine Tim es secuestrado con tres convictos, a una isla y obligado a participar en un juego mortal.

programme.title: Venganza al Trono
programme.desc: Una epopeya de espadas y brujería ambientada a finales del siglo XIII en Malta. Un grupo de guerreros maltrechos topa con un fuerte después de una sangrienta batalla. Los acontecimientos rápidamente se convierten en un torbellino de intriga, sexo y brutales enfrentamientos medievales.

Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. programme.desc: Mr Bean decides to stay in bed all day.

programme.title: Mr Bean
programme.desc: Mr Bean finds that cleanliness can be a filthy business.

programme.title: Mr Bean
programme.desc: At an amusement arcade, Teddy accidentally gets put in a claw machine as a prize!

programme.title: Mr Bean
programme.desc: Mr Bean and Teddy go bowling.

programme.title: Mr Bean
programme.desc: Mr Bean finds that cleanliness can be a filthy business.

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.

programme.title: Night Moves
programme.desc: Three radical environmentalists look to execute the protest of their lives: the explosion of a hydroelectric dam.

programme.title: Anna
programme.desc: A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.

programme.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
programme.desc: After a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of Earth.

programme.title: Prime Orbit
programme.desc: When Earth is facing imminent collision with an asteroid, Manuel must survive a last resort automated space program to save the planet in hopes of reuniting with his brother.

programme.title: Point B
programme.desc: Four friends and Graduate students in the physics department of their University discover their clean energy machine actually works as a crude, rudimentary teleportation device. Through experimentation, adjustments and some misuse-use of the device, it is quickly discovered that the machine holds many consequences.

programme.title: Exile
programme.desc: After an alien saves his life, a rebellious teenager tries to become a part of the strange society that killed his mother.

programme.title: Listening
programme.desc: Grad students invent mind-reading technology that destroys their lives and threatens the future of free will itself.

programme.title: Day of the Comet
programme.desc: The summer of 1986. Halley’s comet races around the earth for the first time in 76 years. Three losers in a small town, believing that what they are seeing is your run-of-the-mill shooting star, each make a wish for a better life. But when their wishes are granted too literally, the neighborhood plunges into total chaos.

programme.title: Alien Reptilian Legacy
programme.desc: Researchers reveal the presence of a supreme interdimensional intelligence that has been manipulating mankind for centuries. Interviews with experiencers and alien abductees expose a sinister agenda behind the alien presence on Earth.

programme.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
programme.desc: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

programme.title: Assimilate (aka Replicate)
programme.desc: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH), Randy (Calum Worthy), and Kayla (Andi Matichak, HALLOWEEN) discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by perfect copies of their victims. Their only chance to survive is to covertly record the invasion in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

programme.title: Titan
programme.desc: Titan, Saturn's largest moon, is the main stage of the Mission Cronos. Orpheus, one of the astronauts who has descended to its surface, is searching for organic life forms. This is his story.

programme.title: Bravestorm
programme.desc: In the year 2050 mankind is extinct. The last survivors travel back in time to stop the invader, the Killgis, in a battle of giant robots.

programme.title: Final Voyage
programme.desc: Two men on the run encounter an old abandoned spaceship in the desert. They escape their pursuers into space and set off in search of a new home.

programme.title: Tangent Room
programme.desc: Trapped in a room with no escape, four brilliant minds race against time to prevent a cosmic collapse of the universe.

programme.title: Olivia
programme.desc: Janis, a child Cello prodigy, has struggled in her adult life with a split personality disorder and has willingly yielded to the control of her husband/therapist who, with the excuse of striving for her cure, has manipulated her all along through medication and psychological torture. He keeps her virtually imprisoned at his home in an isolated island where she spends her life fighting a never-ending battle inside her multiple personalities.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

programme.title: Police Story: Lockdown
programme.desc: The highly-anticipated fifth installment of the Police Story franchise, starring Jackie Chan in a story of family ties, betrayal, and revenge.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Earth has been conquered by robots from a distant galaxy. Survivors are confined to their houses and must wear electronic implants, risking incineration by robot sentries if they venture outside.

programme.title: Run Baby Run
programme.desc: Diana, deaf from birth, begins her training in an idyllic rural landscape, until she comes across a mysterious runner. Hidden behind the darkness of the hood of his sweatshirt, the runner and Diana begin a small running competition that degenerates into a desperate battle for survival. Diana will have to use all her resources, wit, and willpower to survive the violent attack of her pursuer.

programme.title: Secrets
programme.desc: After her mother's passing, Sammy, a resilient single mother, grapples with the looming threat of a breakdown while keeping her mysterious past hidden. Ava, Sammy's daughter, has hidden a desire to uncover the identity of her father, sensing his significant influence on her identity. The journey to bury her grandmother becomes Ava's chance to delve into her origins, but her exploration uncovers more than she intended to reveal.

programme.title: St. Agatha
programme.desc: A pregnant con woman on the run seeks refuge in a desolate convent, only to be met with an unsettling and horrendous evil waiting on the other side.

programme.title: Terrifier
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to the timid town of Miles County where he targets a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween night.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: After being resurrected by a sinister entity, Art the Clown returns to Miles County where he begins to target a teenage girl and her younger brother on Halloween.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: The Golem
programme.desc: A mystical woman must save her village from invaders, but the entity she conjures to protect them is a far greater evil.

programme.title: The Lingering
programme.desc: When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?

programme.title: Wind Walkers
programme.desc: With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.

programme.title: Bad Milo
programme.desc: A man learns that his unusual stomach pains are being caused by a demon living in his intestines.

programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Kiss Of The Damned
programme.desc: A blossoming romance between a vampire and a human is endangered by an unexpected visit.

programme.title: Monsters
programme.desc: After Earth has suffered an alien invasion a journalist escort an American tourist through an infected zone.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson, the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler in to a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where he is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's cousin, Melancholia, wants to marry Clarence P. Harvey after most of her marital prospects have joined the Foreign Legion. Clarence recoils when Melancholia puts on a campaign to win him, backed by Morticia, Gomez and Clarence's boss.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion, after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama's paintings leave an art critic speechless, so Gomez sends for his friend, Sam Picasso, to teach Grandmama to paint in the abstract. The starving artist ignores Grandmama's and Morticia's work as he eats and paints.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can affect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Mr. Briggs, the postman, is hired by the government to do undercover work in the Addams house. While pretending to be a stamp collector, he investigates rumors that coded radio messages are being sent from the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she an Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family would like to vacation on the moon, but the billion dollar travel cost is slightly prohibitive. Uncle Fester volunteers $21.13 and Morticia, using Gomez's new supercomputer, suggests placing a $2,000 bet on the daily double horse race.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Thing disappears from his box. Failing to find a single trace of Thing, Gomez (John Astin) conducts an investigation--with all members of the household under suspicion. Also starring Carolyn Jones, Jackie Coogan, and Ted Cassidy.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester applies for a job as an insurance salesman with the same company which is threatening to cancel the Addamses' policy (because Fester keeps blowing things up). Fester convinces the company interviewer that he is qualified for the job.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Morticia hears the stock market has crashed, she assumes that Gomez has been financially wiped out and rallies the family to help make money. Morticia gives lessons, Lurch and Fester run an escort service, and the kids run a poison drink stand.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Moriticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Taken in by a psychologist's pronouncement that the only happily married couples are those who fight, members of the Addams household devise schemes to start a battle between Gomez (John Astin) and Morticia (Carolyn Jones).

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez visit Mayor Henson to complain that their property tax is ridiculously low. After the Mayor proves his incompetence by offering a refund, Gomez is persuaded to become a candidate for the office.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter, Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fill in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton) comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: Beethoven -- Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra and Chorus in a recorded performance of Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 at Barbican Hall in London.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky Symphony 2 & Elgar's Enigma Variations
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy's oldest opera and arts festival.

programme.title: Verdi - Messa da Requiem
programme.desc: Roberto Abbado conducts the Filarmonica Arturo Toscanini, the Coro del Teatro Regio di Parma, and four vocal soloists in an outstanding performance of Giuseppe Verdi's Messa da Requiem.

programme.title: Rachmaninov & Gershwin: Rhapsodies
programme.desc: The National Philharmonic Orchestra of Russia and acclaimed Russian pianist Boris Berezovsky are conducted by Konstantin Khvatynets in an interpretation of works by Rachmaninov and George Gershwin from Moscow's Tchaikovsky Concert Hall.

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: By popular demand, Canada's Ballet Jörgen reprises the tragic tale of the Russian Grand Duchess Anastasia, 10 years after the ballet's premiere and 100 years after Anastasia's story.

programme.title: Puccini - La Boheme
programme.desc: In 2012, Norwegian opera director Stefan Herheim brought Giacomo Puccini's opera La bohème to the stage of the Norwegian National Opera in Oslo; Norwegian conductor Eivind Gullberg Jensen leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the National Opera Oslo.

programme.title: Grieg's Piano Concerto & Beethoven Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: Conductor Jan Latham-Koenig leads the Flanders Symphony Orchestra in a concert recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium; Felix Mendelssohn's concert overture Die Hebrides, Op. 26; Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor, Op. 16.

programme.title: Mahler Song Cycles: Songs on the Death of Children
programme.desc: Mahler's Kindertotenlieder (Songs on the Death of Children) is a deeply personal song cycle for voice and orchestra inspired by Friedrich Rückert's poems about the loss of his children.

programme.title: Fantasymphony: One Concert to Rule them all
programme.desc: Featuring film music hits from Oscar-winning movies such as "The Lord of the Rings," "Game of Thrones," "The Chronicles of Narnia" and "Harry Potter." Concert orchestration based on the original arrangements and instruments of the film scores.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala
programme.desc: A firework display with music from Hollywood films.

programme.title: Hollywood Gala: Award Night at the Symphony
programme.desc: A musical journey through the sounds of Oscar winners, from classics like "Casablanca" and "Citizen Kane" to monumental cinematic works like "The Godfather"; blockbusters with soundtracks that for almost a century have made us shudder, melt and cry.

programme.title: Divas and Diamonds
programme.desc: A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.

programme.title: Symphonies Mozart and Voríšek
programme.desc: Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhausorchester; recorded in Leipzig's Gewandhaus.

programme.title: LSO Performs Boulanger, Dalbavie und Tschaikowsky
programme.desc: Marta Gardolińska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra in a performance recorded at St Luke's in London on May 18th, 2022; the program consists of a variety of works: D'un Matin de Printemps by Lili Boulanger.

programme.title: El Duelo Final
programme.desc: Una luchadora que dejó los ring se ve forzada a volver a la activa cuando su hermana, que entró en el mundo de las luchas ilegales, tiene su vida amenazada por el dueño del torneo, un hombre sádico y capaz de todo.

programme.title: Atrapada En Guantánamo
programme.desc: Uma jovem americana se alista no exército com a intenção de lutar no Iraque e escapar de sua cidade natal. No entanto, ela acaba designada como guarda no campo de detenção da Baía de Guantánamo, bem longe dos combates. Cercada por jihadistas hostis e colegas agressivos, ela inicia uma amizade incomum com um dos detentos.

programme.title: Invasores de Tumbas
programme.desc: Con promesas de tesoros incalculables, dos aventureros modernos se unen para entrar en la antigua tumba de Quin Shi Haung y evitar que un loco libere el mercurio atrapado en su interior.

programme.title: Jack Hunter
programme.desc: El joven arqueólogo Jack Hunter quiere recuperar una tableta cuneiforme en Siria y deberá robarla de un museo.

programme.title: Rápido Rescate
programme.desc: Cuando una investigación financiada por un rico empresario está a punto de poner fin a la operación de un cártel peligroso, su hija y un valiente soldado deben unirse para entregar pruebas a la policía.

programme.title: Balas en Furia
programme.desc: En la China de la década de 1920, un bandido llega a una remota ciudad de provincia haciéndose pasar por su nuevo alcalde, donde se enfrenta a un tiránico noble local.

programme.title: Cara a Cara
programme.desc: Cheung Sung-bong es un oficial de la Unidad Regional contra el Crimen que trabajó en primera línea durante muchos años. Su protegido, Yau Kong-ngo, lo respeta y logra alcanzarlo. Sin embargo, el destino los enfrenta entre sí.

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Una mujer hermosa pero inestable se obsesiona con un hombre felizmente casado que acaba de mudarse a su vecindario, y se propone destruir cada parte de la vida del matrimonio.

programme.title: Mascara Negra
programme.desc: El superviviente de un proyecto para crear súper soldados deberá luchar contra sus antiguos camaradas como un héroe enmascarado.

programme.desc: Jack es contratado por Dragna, un jefe del crimen, para cumplir con una tarea aparentemente inocente: tiene que llevar un bolso a un motel en Nueva Orleans y esperar que lo pasen a retirar. Pero nunca Jack podrá abrir el bolso. Pero en el momento en que pone un pie en el motel su vida está en juego, varios criminales intentan sacarle el bolso y Jack tiene que defenderlo si quiere vivir

programme.title: El Hechicero Y La Serpiente Blanca
programme.desc: Un monje maestro intenta proteger a un joven e ingenuo médico de un demonio serpiente milenario. Una competencia de poderes psíquicos desata el caos.

programme.title: El Cazador y el Libro Mágico
programme.desc: Un legendario cazador de demonios interpretado por Jackie Chan investiga las desapariciones de las jóvenes de un pueblo. Cuando descubre que fuerzas malignas están secuestrando a las niñas para darse un festín con sus almas, se propone salvar a la humanidad.

programme.title: Venganza al Trono
programme.desc: Una epopeya de espadas y brujería ambientada a finales del siglo XIII en Malta. Un grupo de guerreros maltrechos topa con un fuerte después de una sangrienta batalla. Los acontecimientos rápidamente se convierten en un torbellino de intriga, sexo y brutales enfrentamientos medievales.

programme.title: Masacre en el Barrio Chino
programme.desc: Nick Jackie Chan es un inmigrante chino, que ha entrado ilegalmente en Japón en busca de su novia y de un futuro mejor. Al principio, malvive explotado junto a otros compatriotas con los que arriesga su vida y su libertad a cambio de un mísero salario. Al descubrir, por azar, que su novia es ahora la esposa de un jefe Yakuza, decide entrar en el mundo del crimen organizado convirtiéndose en poco tiempo, con la ayuda del jefe Yakuza a quién casualmente salva la vida, en un auténtico líder, aprendiendo como sobrevivir en un mundo donde la corrupción, el asesinato y las luchas internas entre las distintas mafias, ponen constantemente a prueba su liderazgo y sus principios.
